pairs: Nonne Deo subjecta erit anima mea?
Will my soul not be subject to God?
For from him is my salvation.
Nam et ipse Deus meus et salutaris meus;
Yes, he himself is my God and my salvation.
I will be moved no more.
How is it that you rush against a man?
Every one of you puts to death,
as if you were pulling down a ruined wall,
So, truly, they intended to reject my price.
ore suo benedicebant, et corde suo maledicebant.
They blessed with their mouth and cursed with their heart.
Verumtamen Deo subjecta esto, anima mea, quoniam ab ipso patientia mea:
Yet, truly, my soul will be subject to God. For from him is my patience.
quia ipse Deus meus et salvator meus,
For he is my God and my Savior.
In Deo salutare meum et gloria mea;
In God is my salvation and my glory.
He is the God of my help,
et spes mea in Deo est.
and my hope is in God.
Pour out your hearts in his sight.
God is our helper for eternity.
So, truly, the sons of men are untrustworthy.
The sons of men are liars in the scales, so that,
ut decipiant ipsi de vanitate in idipsum.
by emptiness, they may deceive among themselves.
do not be willing to set your heart on them.
and that mercy belongs to you,
quia tu reddes unicuique juxta opera sua.
O Lord. For you will repay each one according to his works.
